note: Phoenix business ontology — terms as used in evidence, ledgers, and the business twin. Numbers never live here; they live in ledgers with as-of dates.

terms.Opportunity: A candidate transaction (liquidation/solver fill) detected by the engine with exact fee tier, pool, direction, asset, amount, min-profit. Never revenue until reconciled.
terms.Candidate: An opportunity that passed prefilter, exact state validation, dual-provider agreement, and conservative economics.
terms.Attempt: A bounded execution attempt (shadow, simulate, or live) for one candidate.
terms.Submission: A transaction broadcast to the network. NOT profit.
terms.Reconciliation: Post-submission recording of receipt, balances, and economics. The only source of Realized Net PnL.
terms.RealizedNetPnL: Net profit after all known costs and reserves, from reconciliation only. Integer math, conservative.
terms.ExpectedPnL: Modeled expected value before costs. Labeled expected; never called realized.
terms.ConservativePnL: Expected value after all fees, gas, premium, ordering cost, slippage, uncertainty reserve. Must exceed retained-profit floor.
terms.ShadowPnL: What would have been realized had the system been live. Labeled shadow; never revenue.
terms.Lane: One of aave_liquidation, atlas_solver, generic_dex — separate authority domains, armed/killed independently.
terms.RetainedProfitFloor: Minimum conservative net PnL required to execute. Never lowered to manufacture activity.
terms.Funnel: Detected -> relevant -> eligible -> candidate -> submitted -> reconciled stages with conversion counts.
terms.AddressableOpportunity: Value of the market segment Phoenix could capture with capability, minus segments excluded by policy/universe.
terms.NoAlpha: A proven state: conservative net PnL below floor across the measured universe (e.g. 0/4556 forks for the WETH universe). Narrow-scope proof only.
terms.CapabilityGap: A lost-opportunity state: market shows winners Phoenix could not capture (SVR flows, non-WETH debt) due to universe/route limits.
terms.EngineeringDay: One agent/engineer day of work; EV per engineering day compares opportunity value to build cost.
terms.GroundTruthLedger: Dated evidence ledger of actual liquidations/winners vs Phoenix capture (expected/conservative/realized per event).
terms.EvidenceClaim: A business or technical claim with sources, freshness stamp, and classification (FACT/HYPOTHESIS/PROPOSAL/UNKNOWN).
